        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();
        
        long ans = 1;
        int[] vis = new int[(int)p];
        long start = (k == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        for (long i = start; i < p; i++) {
            if (vis[(int)i] != 0)

            do {
                vis[(int)j] = 1;
                j = (j * k) % p;
            } while (j != i && j != 0);
            ans *= p;
            ans %= 1000000007;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
